name: Natural
description: Provides payment rails purpose-built for AI agents, letting them hold funds in wallets and vaults, transfer money, and transact with humans or other agents under policy limits.

skills.name: Agent Wallets
skills.description: Issues wallets an agent controls programmatically, holding balances it can spend within configured limits.

skills.name: Vault Custody
skills.description: Holds reserve funds in vaults separate from spending wallets so agent access is bounded by design.

skills.name: Agent-To-Agent Transfers
skills.description: Moves money between agents and humans over the API, settling autonomous transactions without a checkout flow.
